purpose: Execute the still-unobserved Stage D fixture and power block under an explicitly eager vLLM runtime that bypasses the outcome-independent CUDA-graph startup failure observed in v4.9.

history.justification: v4.9 ended during vLLM CUDA-graph initialization before server liveness, every request sentinel, and every feasibility output. v4.10 is the one separately frozen eager-runtime successor authorized after signed evidence and adversarial review; it does not rerun v4.9.

scientific_inheritance.policy: Datasets, prompts, selected adapter bytes, model and revision, addresses, seeds, sampling, replay, targets, denominators, thresholds, decision rules, future arms, and metrics are inherited unchanged. The named runtime change is enforce_eager=false to true, applied symmetrically.
scientific_inheritance.shared_runtime_policy: The exact eager config must be used by the fixture, power audit, every future scientific arm and baseline, and every evaluation.
scientific_inheritance.eager_equivalence_claim: No numerical or distributional equivalence to CUDA-graph mode is claimed.
scientific_inheritance.joint_pass_rule: at least 58 of 64 unique papers are both eligible and informative

runtime.live_pre_request_gate: After health and before the first fixture sentinel, require the actual vLLM engine log to contain enforce_eager=True, reject CUDA graph profiling or capture, and write EAGER_RUNTIME_PREFLIGHT_PASSED.

transfer.submodules: clean pinned commits required before overlay
transfer.artifact_overlay_policy: Copy the existing compressed adapter and ignored frozen evidence separately by exact hash; never copy CUDA caches, uv caches, merged models, or optimizer state.

request_boundaries.eager_runtime: EAGER_RUNTIME_PREFLIGHT_PASSED is written only after live eager-log validation and before FIXTURE_REQUESTS_STARTED.
request_boundaries.fixture: The inherited runner writes FIXTURE_REQUESTS_STARTED immediately before its first live fixture command.
request_boundaries.power: The inherited runner writes POWER_REQUESTS_STARTED immediately before its first live power command.
request_boundaries.address_reuse_justification: Every v4.9 request count is signed as zero; no fixture, power, or scientific output exists.

repair_policy.after_any_fixture_request: terminal for that address; no silent retry or same-address reuse
repair_policy.after_any_power_request: terminal for the power block; no silent retry or same-address reuse
repair_policy.successor_beyond_v4_10: requires explicit user authorization and a new preregistration

budget.hardware_amendment_rule: rate_usd_per_hour * authorized_total_billed_pod_lifetime_seconds / 3600 + 0.227 must be no greater than 5.7377
budget.hardware_amendment_lifetime_contract: Freeze an absolute total billed pod-lifetime cap and a local supervisor that terminates by that age. Wrapper timeout plus provisioning, SSH, sync, the 120-second kill grace, recovery, and teardown must fit within the total cap; at least 2700 seconds are reserved outside the wrapper.

hardware.selection: cheapest genuinely available qualifying resource after a committed hardware-only amendment
hardware.pods: at most one; resume a single exact v4.10 pod rather than create a duplicate
hardware.ssh: verify noninteractively with C:/Users/mihir/.ssh/id_rsa before sync or model work

authorization.fixture_and_power_model_calls: authorized only after every frozen transfer, source, generated-runner, path, loader, dry-run, and live eager-runtime preflight passes
authorization.next_if_power_passes: terminate support compute, recover and verify artifacts, then separately freeze and adversarially audit the scientific campaign before any scientific model call
authorization.next_if_power_fails: stop Stage D initialization engineering as already preregistered

always_local: all inherited fixture and power artifacts
artifact_policy.retained_model_artifact: the already-local compressed step-8 adapter only
artifact_policy.teardown: always terminate compute and confirm zero persistent disks
